question: Can I Capture Only Part of a Pre-Authorized Payment?
metaDescription: Often yes, if the gateway and its WooCommerce integration both support it — common for split shipments where one item is out of stock.
shortAnswer: Many gateways support capturing less than the originally authorized amount, which is genuinely useful when an order ships in parts and one item turns out to be unavailable — capturing only for what actually shipped avoids overcharging the customer. Whether this is possible through WooCommerce specifically depends on the gateway plugin's own integration; not every plugin exposes partial capture even when the underlying gateway supports it.

bodyHtml:
How Partial Capture Works

An authorization reserves a specific amount, but capture doesn't have to claim that entire amount — most card networks allow capturing any amount up to (but not exceeding) what was originally authorized. Whatever isn't captured is simply released back to the customer's available balance once the authorization expires (or immediately, depending on the gateway).

Where This Actually Matters

  • Split shipments, where one or more items in a multi-item order become unavailable after the order was placed — capturing only for the items that actually ship, rather than the full original amount, avoids the need for a separate refund step.
  • Weight- or quantity-adjusted orders in some industries (food, bulk goods) where the exact final amount isn't known until fulfillment, making an authorize-then-adjust-capture flow more accurate than a fixed upfront charge.
  • Not every gateway's WooCommerce integration exposes this, even when the underlying gateway API supports partial capture — this needs specific confirmation rather than assuming it works because the concept is common industry-wide.
  • Multiple partial captures against a single authorization are sometimes possible but often more restricted (a single capture only, in many integrations) — worth testing the specific limits before relying on it for a complex fulfillment workflow.

Setting This Up

  1. Confirm partial capture support specifically in the WooCommerce integration being used, not just the gateway's general API documentation.
  2. Test the exact split-shipment scenario on a staging environment, confirming the captured amount and the released remainder both behave as expected.
  3. Build the capture trigger into the fulfillment workflow (triggered when a shipment is confirmed, for instance) rather than relying on a fully manual process.

Need a custom partial-capture workflow built around your fulfillment process? See custom WooCommerce development.
